verdict.rationale: LocalAI has a public documentation site, so offering llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for it. Direct probes found no such docs: llms.txt, the markdown variant of the getting-started doc, and all candidate OpenAPI spec paths each returned HTTP 404. The pack's MCP, agent and OpenAI-compatible API material concerns other capabilities and does not show machine-readable docs meant for agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
